subject: Re: only first tab on tabsetPanel loads if submitButton is used

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: only first tab on tabsetPanel loads if submitButton is used
parts:
This is a bug. I just checked in a fix, can you see if it fixes it? You'll need to install this specific build of Shiny:

install.packages("devtools")   # if necessary
devtools::install_github("shiny", "jcheng5", "fix-submit-button")

and then restart R. Thanks.


On Mon, Apr 29, 2013 at 2:52 AM, Jin Rou New <newj...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all,

I noticed that only the first tab on my tabsetPanel (here the Log panel) would load if I have submitButton in my sidebarPanel. Once I comment out the sidebarPanel, the other tabs Plot and Results load perfectly. Has anyone encountered such a problem and know why/how to fix it?

Thanks!

#----------------------------------------------------------------------
ui.R
#----------------------------------------------------------------------
sidebarPanel(
  ...
  submitButton("Start run"), ...
)

 mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(id = "outputpanels",
                tabPanel("Log", verbatimTextOutput("log")),
                tabPanel("Plot", plotOutput("resultsPlot")),
                tabPanel("Results", tableOutput("resultsView"))
                
    )
  )
